PLAN "12-Week Vegan Muscle Gain"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Muscle hypertrophy and strength"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Push":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Upper Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bent_over_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
